source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 7 (PDF 144-166), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Reaction Kinetics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Reaction kinetics is the study of:
(Reaction kinetics kis cheez ka mutala hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction kinetics chemical reactions ke rates (raftaar) ka mutala hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Reaction kinetics is the study of the rates of chemical reactions.

blocks.prompt:
2 Besides reaction rates, the experimental methods of reaction kinetics are used to find:
(Reaction rates ke ilawa reaction kinetics ke tajurbati tareeqon se kya maloom kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetics mein reaction rates, orders aur mechanisms maloom karne ke tajurbati tareeqe shamil hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: experimental methods for measuring reaction rates, orders and mechanisms

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following reactions is described in the chapter as very fast?
(Chapter mein in mein se kaunsa reaction bohat tez bataya gaya hai?)

options.text: catalyst ke baghair aam temperature par H₂ aur O₂

blocks.explanation: NaCl aur AgNO₃ ka reaction bohat tez hai; ester ki hydrolysis darmiyani aur zang (rusting) aahista hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: the reaction of NaCl with AgNO₃ is very fast

blocks.prompt:
4 The hydrolysis of an ester is an example of a reaction that proceeds:
(Ester ki hydrolysis kis raftaar se hone wale reaction ki misaal hai?)

options.text: second ke chhote se hisse mein

blocks.explanation: Kitaab ester ki hydrolysis ko darmiyani raftaar wala reaction batati hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The hydrolysic of ester proceeds at a moderate rate.

blocks.prompt:
5 An explosion and the rusting of iron differ in that rusting:
(Dhamaka (explosion) aur lohe ko zang lagne mein farq yeh hai ke zang lagna:)

options.text: second ke chhote hisse mein hota hai
is ka rate bohat bara hai
aahista hai aur dinon ya mahinon leta hai

blocks.explanation: Dhamaka second ke hisse mein hota hai jabke zang lagna aahista amal hai jo dinon ya mahinon leta hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: the rusting of iron is a slow process that may take days or months

blocks.prompt:
6 In industry, the rates of reactions and their control are important because they may decide whether a reaction:
(Industry mein reactions ke rates aur un ka control kyun aham hai?)

options.text: mass ke tahaffuz ke qanoon ko maanta hai
kifayat se (economically) istemal ho sakta hai

blocks.explanation: Rates aur un ka control yeh faisla kar sakte hain ke reaction kifayat (economically) se istemal ho sakta hai ya nahi (7.1).

book_ref.quote: They might be the deciding factors that determine whether a certain chemical reaction may be used economically or not.

blocks.prompt:
7 According to collision theory, for a reaction to take place the reactant particles must:
(Collision theory ke mutabiq reaction hone ke liye reactant particles ko kya karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Reactants ke particles ko homogeneous mixture bana kar aapas mein takrana (collide) chahiye (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Collision theory explains how reactions occur.

blocks.prompt:
8 Effective collisions take place only when the colliding particles possess a certain amount of energy and:
(Effective collisions sirf tab hoti hain jab takrane wale particles ke paas khaas energy ho aur:)

options.text: durust rukh (proper orientation) se aik doosre ke qareeb aayein

blocks.explanation: Effective collision ke liye kaafi energy aur durust rukh (proper orientation) dono zaroori hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: approach each other with the proper orientation

blocks.prompt:
9 When a collision between reactant particles is ineffective, the particles:
(Jab reactant particles ki takkar ineffective ho to particles:)

options.text: baghair badle wapas uchhal jaate hain

blocks.explanation: Effective takkar se products bante hain; warna particles bas wapas uchhal jaate hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: otherwise the colliding particles just bounce back

blocks.prompt:
10 The minimum amount of energy required for an effective collision between reacting species is called:
(Reacting species ki effective takkar ke liye darkaar kam se kam energy ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Effective takkar ke liye kam se kam energy activation energy kehlati hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The minimum amount of energy, required for an effective collision between the reacting species, is called activation energy.

blocks.prompt:
11 Most reactions are slow. According to the chapter this shows that:
(Aksar reactions aahista hote hain. Chapter ke mutabiq is se kya zahir hota hai?)

options.text: saari takkarein barabar effective nahi hoteen
har takkar se products bante hain

blocks.explanation: Aksar reactions ka aahista hona batata hai ke saari takkarein barabar effective nahi hoteen (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Most of the reactions are slow, showing that all the collisions are not equally effective.

blocks.prompt:
12 On a graph of potential energy against the path of reaction, the reactants at the peak of the curve form the:
(Potential energy aur reaction ke raaste ke graph mein curve ki choti par reactants kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reactants curve ki choti par pohanch kar activated complex banate hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: The reactants reach the peak of the curve to form the activated complex.

blocks.prompt:
13 The rate of a reaction is the change in concentration of a reactant or product divided by:
(Reaction ka rate reactant ya product ki concentration ki tabdeeli ko kis se taqseem karke milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = concentration ki tabdeeli / us tabdeeli mein laga waqt (7.2).

book_ref.quote: The rate of a reaction is defined as the change in the concentration of a reactant or a product divided by the time taken for the change.

blocks.prompt:
14 When concentration is in mol dm⁻³ and time in seconds, the unit of reaction rate is:
(Jab concentration mol dm⁻³ aur waqt seconds mein ho to rate ki unit kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = concentration/waqt = mol dm⁻³ / s = mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (7.2).

book_ref.quote: thus the units for the reaction rate are mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
15 For a slow reaction, the rate may be expressed in:
(Aahista reaction ka rate kis unit mein likha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aahista reactions ke liye units mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ ya mol dm⁻³ h⁻¹ bhi ho sakti hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: for a slow reaction the units may be mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ or even mol dm⁻³ h⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
16 For a gas phase reaction, the rate may be expressed using units of:
(Gas phase reaction ke rate mein molar concentration ki jagah kis ki units istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gas phase reactions mein molar concentration ki jagah pressure (dabao) ki units istemal hoti hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: For a gas phase reaction, units of pressure are used in the place of molar concentrations.

blocks.prompt:
17 For A → B, the rate is written as −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt. The negative sign with Δ[A]/Δt shows that:
(A → B ke liye rate = −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt. Δ[A]/Δt ke saath manfi nishan kya batata hai?)

options.text: A ki concentration kam ho rahi hai

blocks.explanation: Manfi nishan reactant A ki concentration ke kam hone ko zahir karta hai; product ka nishan musbat hai kyunke [B] barhta hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: Since the concentration of product increases with time, the sign in rate expression involving the change of concentration of product is positive.

blocks.prompt:
18 On a concentration-time graph for A → B, the slope of the curves is steepest:
(A → B ke concentration-time graph par curves ki dhalwan (slope) sab se zyada kab hoti hai?)

options.text: jab dono curves parallel ho jaayein

blocks.explanation: Reactant ya product ki slope shuru mein sab se zyada hoti hai, yani tabdeeli sab se tez hoti hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: The slope of the graph for the reactant or the product is steepest at the beginning.

blocks.prompt:
19 As the reaction A → B proceeds, the slope of its concentration-time curves becomes less steep. This shows that:
(Jaise jaise A → B aage barhta hai, curves ki slope kam ho jati hai. Is se kya pata chalta hai?)

options.text: reaction waqt ke saath aahista ho raha hai
mazeed reactant daala ja raha hai

blocks.explanation: Kam slope ka matlab hai reaction waqt ke saath aahista ho raha hai; rate har lamhe badalta hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: the slope becomes less steep indicating that the reaction is slowing down with time

blocks.prompt:
20 The concentration of a reactant falls from 0.80 mol dm⁻³ to 0.50 mol dm⁻³ in 60 s. The average rate of the reaction is:
(Aik reactant ki concentration 60 s mein 0.80 mol dm⁻³ se 0.50 mol dm⁻³ ho jati hai. Average rate kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Where Δx is a very small change in the concentration of a reactant or a product in a very small time interval Δt.

blocks.prompt:
21 A rate of 0.012 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ expressed in mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ is:
(0.012 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ ka rate mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ mein kitna hoga?)

book_ref.quote: Usually, the concentration is expressed in mol dm⁻³ and the time in second

blocks.prompt:
22 The rate at any one instant during a time interval is called the:
(Waqt ke kisi waqfe mein kisi aik lamhe par rate ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Waqfe ke dauran kisi aik lamhe ka rate instantaneous rate (fauri rate) hai (7.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The rate at any one instant during the interval is called the instantaneous rate.

blocks.prompt:
23 The rate of reaction over a time period between two specific times is called the:
(Do mukhtalif auqaat ke darmiyan poore waqfe ka rate kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Average rate do khaas auqaat ke darmiyan, yani aik waqfe par, reaction ka rate hai (7.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The rate of reaction between two specific time intervals or the rate over a time period

blocks.prompt:
24 In any time interval, the average rate and the instantaneous rate are equal:
(Kisi bhi waqfe mein average rate aur instantaneous rate kab barabar hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono rates kisi waqfe mein sirf aik lamhe ke liye barabar hote hain (7.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The average rate and instantaneous rate are equal for only one instant in any time interval.

blocks.prompt:
25 At the beginning of a time interval, compared with the average rate, the instantaneous rate is:
(Waqfe ke shuru mein average rate ke muqable mein instantaneous rate kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein instantaneous rate average se zyada hota hai; aakhir mein kam ho jata hai (7.2.1).

book_ref.quote: At first, the instantaneous rate is higher than the average rate.

blocks.prompt:
26 At the end of a time interval, the instantaneous rate becomes:
(Waqfe ke aakhir mein instantaneous rate kaisa ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Waqfe ke aakhir mein instantaneous rate average rate se kam ho jata hai (7.2.1).

book_ref.quote: At the end of the interval the instantaneous rate becomes lower than the average rate.

blocks.prompt:
27 In the reaction N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), the concentration of ammonia is 2.0 mol dm⁻³ after 2.0 min and 5.6 mol dm⁻³ after 5.0 min. The average rate of formation of NH₃ in this interval is:
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein ammonia ki concentration 2.0 min par 2.0 mol dm⁻³ aur 5.0 min par 5.6 mol dm⁻³ hai. Is waqfe mein NH₃ banne ka average rate kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Rate of formation of NH₃ = ΔC/Δt = Δ[NH₃]/Δt = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ / 3 min = 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
28 The instantaneous rate of a reaction at a given time is found from:
(Kisi khaas waqt par reaction ka instantaneous rate kaise maloom hota hai?)

options.text: kul tabdeeli ko kul waqt se taqseem karke
us waqt par concentration-time curve ke tangent (mamas) ki slope

blocks.explanation: Instantaneous rate us waqt par concentration-time curve ke tangent (mamas) ki slope se milta hai (7.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The slope of the tangent is the rate of reaction at that point i.e., after 100 seconds.

blocks.text: 7.2.2 Measuring the rate of a chemical reaction

blocks.prompt:
29 Measuring the rate of a chemical reaction involves determining the concentration of reactants or products:
(Chemical reaction ka rate naapne ke liye reactants ya products ki concentration kab maloom ki jati hai?)

options.text: sirf reaction shuru hone se pehle
sirf reaction mukammal hone ke baad
reaction ke dauran baqaida waqfon par

blocks.explanation: Reaction ke dauran baqaida waqfon par concentrations maloom ki jati hain (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: determination of the concentration of reactants or products at regular time intervals

blocks.prompt:
30 For 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g), the graph of [HI] against time is a falling curve because:
(2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) mein [HI] aur waqt ka graph girta hua curve kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: HI reactant hai, is liye us ki concentration waqt ke saath kam hoti hai (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Since HI is a reactant, so it is a falling curve.

blocks.prompt:
31 To find the rate of reaction at 100 s from a concentration-time curve, one measures:
(Concentration-time curve se 100 s par rate maloom karne ke liye kya naapa jata hai?)

options.text: 100 s tak curve ke neeche area
100 s par banaye gaye tangent ki slope

blocks.explanation: Kisi nuqte par tangent ki slope us nuqte par reaction ka rate hai (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The slope of the tangent is the rate of reaction at that point

blocks.prompt:
32 The steepness of a concentration-time curve reflects:
(Concentration-time curve ki dhalwan (steepness) kis cheez ko zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dhalwan reaction ki pesh-raft (rate) batati hai; slope jitni zyada, rate utna zyada (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Greater the slope of curve near the start of reaction, greater is the rate of reaction.

blocks.prompt:
33 From Table 7.1, [HI] falls from 0.100 mol dm⁻³ at 0 s to 0.0716 mol dm⁻³ at 50 s. The average rate of disappearance of HI in this interval is:
(Table 7.1 mein [HI] 0 s par 0.100 mol dm⁻³ se 50 s par 0.0716 mol dm⁻³ ho jata hai. Is waqfe mein HI ke khatam hone ka average rate kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table 7.1 Change in concentration of HI with regular intervals, 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)

blocks.prompt:
34 Using Table 7.1 ([HI] = 0.0558 mol dm⁻³ at 100 s and 0.0387 mol dm⁻³ at 200 s), the average rate of disappearance of HI between 100 s and 200 s is:
(Table 7.1 se ([HI] 100 s par 0.0558 aur 200 s par 0.0387 mol dm⁻³), 100 s aur 200 s ke darmiyan HI ka average rate kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = (0.0558 − 0.0387)/100 = 1.71 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; shuru se kam, yani reaction aahista ho raha hai (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 7.1 Change in concentration of HI with regular intervals, 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)

blocks.prompt:
35 A tangent drawn on the [HI]-time curve falls by 0.030 mol dm⁻³ over a base of 120 s. The rate at that point is:
([HI]-time curve par banaya gaya tangent 120 s ke base par 0.030 mol dm⁻³ girta hai. Us nuqte par rate kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: A right-angled triangle ABC is completed with a tangent as hypotenuse.

blocks.prompt:
36 For 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g), a graph of [H₂] against time gives:
(2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) mein [H₂] aur waqt ka graph kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: H₂ aur I₂ products hain, is liye un ka graph upar jata hua curve hai (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: If we plot a graph between time on x-axis and concentration of any of the products i.e H₂ or I₂, then a rising curve is obtained.

blocks.prompt:
37 In 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g), if HI is used up at 3.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹, H₂ is formed at:
(2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) mein agar HI 3.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ se khatam ho to H₂ kis rate se banega?)
blocks.explanation: Do mole HI se aik mole H₂ banta hai, is liye H₂ aadhe rate se banta hai: 1.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (7.2.2).

book_ref.quote: two moles of HI give one mole each of H₂ and I₂

blocks.prompt:
38 The change in concentration of reactants or products during a reaction can be determined by:
(Reaction ke dauran reactants ya products ki concentration ki tabdeeli kaise maloom ki ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Concentration ki tabdeeli physical aur chemical dono tareeqon se maloom ki ja sakti hai (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: can be determined by both physical and chemical methods

blocks.prompt:
39 The chemical method of measuring concentration is particularly suitable for reactions:
(Concentration naapne ka chemical tareeqa khaas taur par kin reactions ke liye munasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical tareeqa khaas taur par solution mein hone wale reactions ke liye munasib hai (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: This is particularly suitable for reactions in solution.

blocks.prompt:
40 The acid hydrolysis of ethyl acetate, CH₃COOC₂H₅, gives:
(Ethyl acetate (CH₃COOC₂H₅) ki acid hydrolysis se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O → CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH, H⁺ catalyst ke taur par (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Ethyl acetate is CH₃COOC₂H₅; the printed CH₃COO₂H₅ has lost a carbon atom.

blocks.prompt:
41 In following the hydrolysis of an ester, the withdrawn sample is run into about four times its volume of ice-cold water in order to:
(Ester ki hydrolysis mein nikala gaya sample apne volume ke taqreeban chaar guna barf jaise thande paani mein kyun daala jata hai?)

options.text: dilution aur thanda karke reaction rokne ke liye
catalyst poori tarah nikalne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Paani milana (dilution) aur thanda karna reaction ko rok deta hai, taake us waqt ka acid titrate ho sake (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: run into about four times its volume of ice-cold water

blocks.prompt:
42 In the chemical method for ester hydrolysis, the acid formed is titrated against standard NaOH using:
(Ester hydrolysis ke chemical tareeqe mein banne wale acid ko standard NaOH ke khilaaf kis indicator se titrate kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Banne wala acid standard alkali (NaOH) ke khilaaf phenolphthalein indicator se titrate hota hai (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The acid formed is titrated against a standard alkali, say NaOH, using phenolphthalein as an indicator.

blocks.prompt:
43 Spectrophotometry (colorimetry) can be used to follow a reaction if a reactant or product:
(Spectrophotometry (colorimetry) se reaction tab follow kiya ja sakta hai jab koi reactant ya product:)

options.text: ultraviolet, visible ya infrared radiation jazb kare

blocks.explanation: Yeh tareeqa tab lagta hai jab reactant ya product UV, visible ya IR radiation jazb (absorb) kare (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: This method is applicable if a reactant or a product absorbs ultraviolet, visible or infrared radiation.

blocks.prompt:
44 The electrical conductivity method is used to study the rate of a reaction that:
(Electrical conductivity ka tareeqa kis qisam ke reaction ka rate parhne ke liye hai?)

options.text: sirf non-polar gases par mushtamil ho

blocks.explanation: Ions wale reactions ko electrical conductivity (bijli guzaarne ki salahiyat) ke tareeqe se parha jata hai (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The rate of a reaction involving ions can be studied by electrical conductivity method.

blocks.prompt:
45 The volume change method of following a reaction is useful when the reaction:
(Volume change ka tareeqa kab mufeed hai?)

options.text: gases ke volume mein tabdeeli ho

blocks.explanation: Yeh un reactions ke liye mufeed hai jin mein gases ka volume badalta hai (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: This method is useful for those reactions, which involve changes in volumes of gases

blocks.prompt:
46 The rates of some very fast reactions can be monitored using:
(Kuch bohat tez reactions ke rates kis technique se monitor kiye ja sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stopped-flow spectrophotometry se kuch bohat tez reactions ke rates monitor hote hain (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The rates of some very fast reactions can be monitored using stopped-flow spectrophotometry.

blocks.prompt:
47 In stopped-flow spectrophotometry, the progress of the reaction in the observation cell is usually monitored by measuring:
(Stopped-flow spectrophotometry mein observation cell mein reaction ki pesh-raft aam taur par kaise dekhi jati hai?)

options.text: sample mein se ultraviolet radiation ka guzarna (transmission)

blocks.explanation: Sample mein se ultraviolet radiation ke guzarne (transmission) ko naap kar (7.2.3).

book_ref.quote: usually by measuring the transmission of ultraviolet radiation through the sample

blocks.text: 7.3 Factors affecting the rate of a chemical reaction

blocks.prompt:
48 Which of the following is NOT listed in the chapter as a factor affecting the rate of a reaction?
(In mein se kaunsa chapter mein reaction ke rate par asar daalne wala factor nahi bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Factors yeh hain: concentration, temperature, surface area aur catalyst (7.3).

book_ref.quote: Even a chemical reaction involving the same reactants may have different rates under different conditions.

blocks.prompt:
49 For a reaction between gaseous reactants, increasing the pressure:
(Gaseous reactants ke reaction mein pressure barhane se kya hota hai?)

options.text: gases ki concentration barha kar rate barhata hai
activation energy zero kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada pressure gases ki concentration barhata hai, is liye rate barhta hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: an increase in pressure increases the concentration of the gases which leads to an increase in the rate of reaction

blocks.prompt:
50 A change in pressure has no effect on the rate of a reaction when the reactants are:
(Pressure ki tabdeeli ka rate par koi asar nahi hota jab reactants:)
blocks.explanation: Agar reactants solids ya liquids hon to pressure ka rate par asar nahi hota (7.3).

book_ref.quote: pressure change has no effect on the rate of reaction if the reactants are either solids or liquids

blocks.prompt:
51 According to the law of mass action, the greater the concentration of the reactants:
(Law of mass action ke mutabiq reactants ki concentration jitni zyada ho:)
blocks.explanation: Reactants ki zyada concentration se reaction tez chalta hai (7.3.1).

book_ref.quote: According to the law of mass action, the greater the concentration of the reactants, the more rapidly the reaction proceeds.

blocks.prompt:
52 Increasing the concentration of a reactant increases the rate because it:
(Reactant ki concentration barhane se rate kyun barhta hai?)

options.text: reacting particles ki takkarein zyada karti hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada concentration se particles ki takkarein zyada hoti hain, is liye reaction tez hota hai (7.3.1).

book_ref.quote: increasing the concentration results in more collisions between the reacting particles

blocks.prompt:
53 It has been observed that, for every 10 °C rise in temperature, the rate of a reaction usually:
(Har 10 °C temperature barhne par reaction ka rate aam taur par:)

options.text: do guna ya teen guna ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Har 10 °C barhne par rate do guna ya teen guna ho jata hai (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: rate either doubles or triples for every 10 °C rise in temperature

blocks.prompt:
54 A reaction's rate doubles for every 10 °C rise. If the temperature is raised from 25 °C to 55 °C, the rate becomes:
(Aik reaction ka rate har 10 °C par do guna hota hai. Temperature 25 °C se 55 °C karne par rate kitna guna hoga?)
blocks.explanation: 30 °C = teen dafa 10 °C; rate × 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 guna (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: rate either doubles or triples for every 10 °C rise in temperature

blocks.prompt:
55 Molecules at a higher temperature collide more frequently and with greater energy because they have:
(Zyada temperature par molecules zyada aur zyada energy se kyun takrate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada temperature par molecules ke paas zyada thermal (harari) energy hoti hai (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Molecules at higher temperatures have more thermal energy.

blocks.prompt:
56 The Boltzmann distribution curve shows:
(Boltzmann distribution curve kya dikhata hai?)

options.text: waqt ke saath concentration ki tabdeeli
reaction ke raaste par potential energy
kisi temperature par molecular energies ki taqseem

blocks.explanation: Boltzmann curve kisi khaas temperature par molecules ki energies ki taqseem dikhata hai (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The Boltzmann distribution curve is a graph that shows the distribution of energies at certain temperature.

blocks.prompt:
57 In a reaction mixture at a given temperature, according to the Boltzmann distribution:
(Kisi temperature par reaction mixture mein Boltzmann distribution ke mutabiq:)

options.text: zyada tar ki bohat zyada energy
kuch ki bohat kam, kuch ki bohat zyada, aur zyada tar ki darmiyani energy

blocks.explanation: Kuch particles ki energy bohat kam, kuch ki bohat zyada aur zyada tar ki darmiyani hoti hai (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: many particles will have energy in between

blocks.prompt:
58 On a Boltzmann distribution curve, the shaded area beyond Eₐ shows the number of particles that:
(Boltzmann curve par Eₐ ke baad shaded area un particles ki tadaad batata hai jo:)

options.text: activation energy se zyada energy rakhte hain
sirf sab se aam energy rakhte hain

blocks.explanation: Shaded area un particles ko dikhata hai jin ki energy Eₐ se zyada hai (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: The shaded area shows the number of particles with energy greater than the activation energy, Eₐ.

blocks.prompt:
59 As the temperature of a reaction mixture is raised, the average kinetic energy of the particles:
(Reaction mixture ka temperature barhane par particles ki average kinetic energy:)
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhane se particles ki average kinetic (harkat ki) energy barhti hai (7.3.2).

book_ref.quote: the average kinetic (movement) energy of the particles increases

blocks.prompt:
60 Compared with the Boltzmann curve at T₁, the curve at a higher temperature T₂:
(T₁ ke muqable mein zyada temperature T₂ par Boltzmann curve:)
